scope: Publication footprint, one source-language course body, search formula duplication, and release-input inspection. No new textbook content or translation in this turn.

changes.mathSearch: MathML and its original TeX annotation remain in the DOM for accessibility. Only their duplicate search text is ignored; visible KaTeX HTML remains indexed.
changes.courseOriginals: 575 redundant English source-archive bodies replaced with direct canonical aliases. Full source-language bodies, code and images remain on canonical source routes. Course hubs and real English editions are not deduplicated.
changes.compatibility: Old EN source addresses retain query strings and fragments; aliases are noindex and link directly to a non-redirect original.
changes.coursePdfs: 20 linked complete lecture PDFs now open at their recorded official origins. Commit-pinned GitHub blobs use the corresponding raw file URL. Local originals are unchanged.
changes.longSourceCode: Archive listings of at least 5000 characters use plaintext highlighting. No truncation or source-text edits; textbook examples retain their original highlighting.
changes.sizeGate: Pages upload now requires the full uncompressed artifact to fit within 1000000000 bytes.

astroCheck.scope: 24 files, before the later source-alias adapter change; final adapter behavior covered by full unit/build checks.

sourceImages.scope: Current canonical HTML counts plus the retained source hashes; not fresh visual acceptance of every source figure.

officialLecturePdfLinks.scope: Availability only; no new remote PDF-byte comparison.

diffCheck.wholeTree: retained source archives contain Markdown hard-break whitespace and original-source whitespace; not rewritten to satisfy git diff --check

secretPatternScan.scope: Text files up to 8 MB, common token/private-key patterns; not a complete security or personal-data audit.

sourceListing.decoding: Join EC line text with LF, decode only EC's empty-line LF placeholder, restore the terminal LF.

mobile.scope: Canonical source listing reached through the Pages EN alias; horizontal scrolling stays inside code.

search.root: 23 GPT-3 results; learning-rate formula appears once, without TeX annotation.
search.pages: Same query and corrected snippet verified in /bookvar/en/; source and section URLs retain the project prefix.
